title: Notice of Intent to Modify Existing Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Task Order Contracts for Architect/Engineering Services for Air Force Reserve Projects Nationwide
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION GREAT LAKES AND OHIO.ENDIST LOUISVILLE.W072 ENDIST LOUISVILLE
detail_text: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Louisville District, is issuing a notice of intent to modify existing Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Task Order Contracts for Architect/Engineering Services for Air Force Reserve Projects Nationwide. The modification would add FAR Clause 52.217-8, Option to Extend Services, to add the option for a 6-month extension to the period of performance to the following contracts: W912QR21D0070- Burns & McDonnell Engineering Company W912QR21D0071- Benham-Mead & Hunt W912QR21D0072- Tetra Tech, Inc. W912QR21D0073- Woolpert-RS&H, LLC. W912QR21D0074- Pond- FSB A Joint Venture W912QR21D0075- AEC Emersion Joint Venture W912QR21D0076- Blair Remy Corporation P.C. W912QR21D0077- ETEGRA-COOVERCLARK JV1, LLC W912QR21D0078- Toland & Mizell Architects, Inc.
